title: FLOATING GRID
question: What if a layout reflowed like water?
note: Nine cards float in a shallow tank. Lift one out and the others drift to fill the hole; carry it over the grid and they part to make room; drop it and the neighbours bob in its wake. Nothing snaps, so the reflow you normally miss in a single frame becomes something you watch, and you start reading cause and effect in a layout instead of just its final state.
